title: Prove tagged centre reset and sharp costs for all pure-reset policies
body:
This package gives a local nonlinear centre reset on a declared physical dyadic input grid and a conditional cost theorem for every policy in a fixed pure-reset family. The local word returns `(X-Y,Y)`, restores all 480 helper contents from those grid inputs, clears one owned private field, and adds 2,361 field passes with no added native child. **It does not improve the complete kappa calculation.** Read the [proof](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/27301def7e7319c1a3b5ac20400ed8ee49724f20/research/finite-tagged-centre-reset/PROOF.md), [independent publication review](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/27301def7e7319c1a3b5ac20400ed8ee49724f20/research/publication-reviews/finite-tagged-centre-reset/REVIEW.md), and [source pins](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/27301def7e7319c1a3b5ac20400ed8ee49724f20/research/finite-tagged-centre-reset/SOURCES.json).

The version 2 local proof has a sufficient fine-accuracy profile of 124 rank-one and eight rank-four children, with mass 156. It keeps a separate absolute error budget for parent return rounding. A relative child error bound alone fails for a half-parent-grid output. Exact helper restoration applies after entry to the declared grid; it does not repair finer caller records.

The complete policy theorem covers all `2^36` effective policies through 12,288 exact group cases and all 255 nonempty query subsets. The all-query optimum has 121 rank-one and eight rank-four children, with mass 153. For every nonempty subset, the added rank moment exceeds the removed centre moment by at least 17 for `0 <= sigma <= 1`; 17 is sharp. The class permits individual ideal pure-target resets after existing events before the fixed cut, with free reset cost. It keeps the chronology, basis, access edges, and independent relative-error width model. It is not a universal precision lower bound.

The publication base is `b58ad9ef4d4e861b0eaa5dba41742bdc072dca51`; its [selected record](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/b58ad9ef4d4e861b0eaa5dba41742bdc072dca51/certificates/selected-result.json) identifies [PR #4470](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4470). This package does not prove admission to that changed construction. The historical native lineage is pinned at `bce54fb3f895cbe5cd4c0eb477c3afeed100190f`; the historical precision source revision is `3ae9a6f3ac74ded022ab3b4872a7357a621af6fb`. The [notice](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/27301def7e7319c1a3b5ac20400ed8ee49724f20/research/finite-tagged-centre-reset/NOTICE.md) preserves gauge44/t16 contributor credit and licenses. History-encoding supplied the cut response, circuit-interface supplied the matrix, schur-selection supplied the grid word, temporal-reuse supplied the policy theorem, and the separate reviews supplied the physical correction, return-grid correction, and sharp surplus. The retained source credits @icekylinx for the gauge and pipeline, @FanPUYen for t16, @jeremykothe2 for the retained local word, @chafreaky for the frame and owner constructions, and @rohanarun for the native recurrence correction. Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance was used; no independent human review is claimed.

Use CPython 3.10 or later, the standard library, one process, and at least 3 GiB of free space. From the repository root:

```sh
python3 -I -O -B research/finite-tagged-centre-reset/replay.py --out /tmp/finite-tagged-centre-reset-check
```

The output directory must not exist. The expected final status is:

```text
PASS_FINITE_TAGGED_CENTRE_RESET_PACKAGE
```

Both unchanged independent checkers passed from a [fresh relocated package](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/27301def7e7319c1a3b5ac20400ed8ee49724f20/research/publication-reviews/finite-tagged-centre-reset/REPLAY.json), with complete receipt equality. Checks cover all 704 input columns, all 480 helpers, 11,025 decoder cases, 132 local native-error impulses, every effective policy, and 528 policy-error impulses. [Additional independent controls](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/27301def7e7319c1a3b5ac20400ed8ee49724f20/research/publication-reviews/finite-tagged-centre-reset/ADDITIONAL-CHECKS.json) reject zeroing nonzero helper baselines and verify the exact margins and parent return counterexample. A later input-grid clarification changed only the new proof; the [final hash check](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/27301def7e7319c1a3b5ac20400ed8ee49724f20/research/publication-reviews/finite-tagged-centre-reset/FINAL-DOCUMENT-CHECK.json) binds the accepted package to that replay.

The full native phase and historical record/tape audits remain inherited and were not rerun. Finer-caller entry conversion, complete node endpoint and owner admission, and the finite bit and tape invoice remain open. No complete supplier or frontier update is claimed.
